name: Rakoty Nonprofit Accountants
what_they_do: Accounting firm specialising in nonprofits - nonprofit accounting, audit preparation and support during state-funded audits, fiscal management, plus small-business accounting and tax work. A published client testimonial describes audit preparation and working directly with state auditors.
customers: Nonprofit organisations (including out-of-state ones - the published testimonial is from a Philadelphia nonprofit) and small businesses.

size_signals.signal: Site nav splits Non-Profit / Small Businesses / Taxes and speaks of 'the Rakoty team', implying more than one preparer
Client testimonial from Rising Hope For Change (Philadelphia) describes a state-funded audit engagement
Office inside Brunswick Woods Office Park, 82 Brunswick Woods Dr, per Google Maps

listing.reviews: count not displayed in the limited Maps view I got

website_review.primary_cta: 'Schedule an appointment' in the nav, which just links to /contacts-us/ (no scheduler)
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: none - 'Schedule an appointment' goes to a contact page; no calendar
website_review.trust_signals: Client testimonial, phone number, embedded Google map of the office
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Site is stuck behind a full-screen percentage preloader: at 390px it showed only a logo and '6%', rising to ~25% after ~20 seconds, with no page content; body text never rendered; footer/© notice absent; meta description is an unfinished template string ('Accounting Company or a natural variation like accounting firm with a focus on nonprofits')
website_review.search_basics: Title is 'Rakoty - Nonprofit Accounting company' with no town and no service keyword; meta description is placeholder text; JSON-LD is WebPage/ImageObject/BreadcrumbList/WebSite/Organization with no address, phone or AccountingService type
top_issues: Site never finishes loading - visitors (and crawlers) see a blank preloader screen
Placeholder meta description and a keyword-free title; no town anywhere in the title
No LocalBusiness/AccountingService schema and no real scheduling

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: Maps profile exists with category 'Accounting firm', address, hours and site link, but the limited view showed no review count and no photos; robots.txt is a plain Yoast block with 'Disallow:' empty, so bots are not blocked at that level. Answerable: effectively no - the rendered page contains only a loader percentage, the meta description is placeholder text, and JSON-LD has no address/phone/service type; the only readable copy was a single testimonial block returned by a fetch. Bookable: nothing - 'Schedule an appointment' links to a contact page.

operations_signals.signal: 'Schedule an appointment' is offered in the nav but is not a scheduler, so appointment requests still need manual handling
Nonprofit audit/preparation work with state auditors is document-intensive (per the published testimonial), a natural fit for document-chasing automation

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the site so it loads: remove or slim the full-screen preloader and the oversized assets - the business currently has no working web front door
top_opportunities.evidence: At 390px the page sat at '6%' and reached only ~25% after 20 seconds with no content rendered; fetch returned only a testimonial block

top_opportunities.opportunity: Rewrite title/meta with service + East Brunswick and add LocalBusiness/AccountingService JSON-LD so the firm is answerable to AI search
top_opportunities.evidence: Title 'Rakoty - Nonprofit Accounting company'; meta description is literal placeholder text; JSON-LD lacks address, phone and service type

top_opportunities.opportunity: Nonprofit client document-request and deadline tracker (990, audit PBC lists) to cut manual chasing during audit season
top_opportunities.evidence: Testimonial describes coordinating detailed documentation with state auditors under tight timelines

scores.reasons: Gap: the website is effectively down for visitors and crawlers, plus placeholder SEO copy (5). Ability: niche nonprofit accounting with recurring audit/compliance revenue, but a small firm (3). Ease: performance fix and metadata rewrite are quick, high-impact (5). Evidence: phone screenshot, page JS state, robots.txt and Maps all read directly (4).

wrong_claims.claim: The nav's 'Schedule an appointment' link 'just links to /contacts-us/ (a contact page, no scheduler)'
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The nav button does point to https://rakotygroup.com/contacts-us/, but that URL returns HTTP 404. The live contact page is /contacts/ (nav label 'Contacts Us'), which shows address, phone, email and a Google map but no form.

wrong_claims.claim: website_review contact_form: true (a contact form exists)
wrong_claims.what_is_true: No contact form on any page checked (home, /contacts/, /non-profit-2/, /taxes/): the only <form> is the site-search box; zero Contact Form 7 widgets render even though the plugin script loads.
